health-trend-charts.reason: The pet health page draws 30-day daily trends (weight, temperature, heart rate, 1-5 emotional scores; HEALTH_CHART_WINDOW_DAYS = 30). ChartKit 0.6.0's LineChart labels its time axis only at month or year starts: timeTicks for 2026-10-01..2026-10-27 returns no tick, so a migrated chart rendered with no date on its x axis (dates only on hover and in the hidden table). Migrate when LineChart labels days on spans under two months.

twin-score-meters.reason: The emotional-twin score bar and its per-metric bars are coloured by the twin state and show a translated scale word beside each bar, while the score is printed once, large, above them. ChartKit 0.6.0's Meter takes only value, max, label and href: it has no tone or colour input and always prints its own number beside the track, so it would drop the state colour and repeat the figure.
